# Propagating strawberries from runners in NFT channels

Strawberry plants propagate through runners, the stolons the mother plant sends
out after the first harvest. In nutrient film technique channels the runner is
pinned into a plug of rockwool while still attached, so it roots without
competing with the mother plant for water.

## Rooting and sanitising the channel

A runner roots in eight to twelve days when the plug stays at twenty two degrees
and the film flows continuously. Sever the stolon only after two new leaves open
on the daughter crown; cutting earlier leaves a plant with no root reserve.

Sanitise the channel between batches: the crown rot that survives in biofilm
returns with the first warm week and takes the whole row before the fruit sets.
